verdict.rationale: A probe found an official Runloop MCP server documented on the AI-tools docs page, which describes adding context about the Runloop API to LLMs, so an agent can connect to Runloop through an MCP server. The evidence is thin: it amounts to a probe detection and a one-line page description, with no detail on setup or capabilities. Missing for 10: documented install/connection steps, the list of tools or Devbox operations the server exposes, auth details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
